intro.text: A man named in a family record stored in one of the gemstones of Urithiru's archive, left by his wife before she departed the tower.

items.text: About to leave Urithiru, Wzmal's wife was given the chance to leave a message, recorded in a ruby, and used it to describe her family. She praised Wzmal as the finest husband a woman could hope for.
In the same record she named their children, Kmakra and Molinar.
